SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, g.Country
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Price * t.Amount = 548.4 AND t.Date = '2012-08-24'
LIMIT 1
